s01_bottom_line.text: Morgan Stanley estimates the direct-to-consumer cash-pay opportunity in biopharma could reach $26 billion at peak, with the GLP-1 market already demonstrating that branded prescription products can drive substantial volume through consumer-led access pathways. ⟨cited figures: forecast; approximate⟩

In biopharma alone the direct-to-consumer cash-pay market could reach $26 billion at its peak; GLP-1s gave the first large-scale proof the model works, and a branded product could support roughly half its volume through a consumer-led pathway. ⟨cited figures: forecast; approximate⟩

If consumer-led cash-pay pathways scale as the GLP-1 case suggests, large-cap biopharma firms offering direct-to-consumer platforms could capture incremental volume outside the reimbursement system, though the article does not quantify earnings impact for any named company.
